propositions: Bedrock provider must clear the parity bar before becoming a first-class provider; the bar requires zero decision-level flips on gold set, per-criterion verdict agreement at 0.95+, recall/false-accept within tolerance, zero runtime errors, and 20+ gold coverage.

A paired-corpus harness modeled on fidelity_spot_eval must run the same 30 gold cases through both anthropic and bedrock providers as the only variable, with N=3 epoch majority aggregation and identical payloads/tools reaching both providers.

Step 1 probe must confirm both inference-profile IDs (sonnet-4-6 and opus-4-8) are invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 before corpus spend; opus-4-8 rejects temperature=0 and must carry supports_temperature: False override.

Payload parity must be proven by capture at the provider boundary: system prompt, messages, max_tokens and temperature identical across providers; tool set identical across providers; temperature capability difference is model-driven not provider-driven and symmetric on both providers.
Provider routing must be clean: the bedrock v2 arm must make zero non-Bedrock calls across all case-runs, verified by REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally.

Corporal exclusion must filter out agentic multi-call arms (completion-verifier, ticket-quality, spec-alignment) and case-runs that raise before any model call; pooling across 15 specs yields 30 items meeting the 20-item gold floor without lowering min_gold.
